messages:
jess: Heads-up: saw ~110 leads stuck in 'Unassigned' overnight. pattern looks like enrichment race + webhook order.
diego: solid catch. any single example we can inspect?
emily: grabbed one from the proxy logs: ```{
  "hs_contact": "c_4521",
  "email": "lead+sg@example.com",
  "hs_state": "pending_enrichment",
  "recv_ts": 3312345600
}```
jess: recv_ts 3312345600 then enrichment_ready arrived at 3312345632 but SF created record with owner=null at 3312345615. looks like our SF create runs before the enrichment finalize.
tom: current RR only routes when enrichment_status==ready. if create webhook races first, SF ends up with null owner and downstream automations ignore it.
diego: proposal: add lightweight "claim_lease" flow. assigner writes claim_lease_id into SF custom field owner_lease_c when it tentatively claims. enrichment writes back claim_lease_id and then finalizer will only set owner if lease matches.
emily: that prevents overwrite from stale create webhooks. also add a short TTL 75s on the lease. if TTL expires, lead goes to backlog queue instead of null owner.
jess: backlog queue = owner=backlog@ops with tag hs_needs_review:true. sales-ops can triage. safer than leaving null.
tom: quick deployment plan: 1) proxy: surface claim_lease_id to payload (15m). 2) assigner: set owner_lease_c and TTL, and write tag for pending claims (45m). 3) finalizer: honor claim_lease_id equality before writing owner (30m). 4) reconciler job to sweep null-owner contacts last 1h (45m).
diego: canary: enable claim_lease for 10% of leads region=APAC for 2 hours. emit metric lease_fallback_rate and claim_mismatch_count.
emily: add alert: lease_fallback_rate > 1.5% for 10m => channel notify; >10% => page eng-oncall.
jess: also replay job to backfill the ~110 leads and mark them hs_backfilled:true. who owns that?
tom: I'll run a one-off backfill script after reconciler is live. should be safe.
diego: tiny note: confirm SF workflow rules won't auto-assign owner_lease_c to someone else. I'll check with sales-ops and post in thread.
emily: PRs: "proxy: add claim_lease_id header" and "assigner: tentative lease + backlog fallback". I'll open both now and tag tom/diego.
hs-bot: webhook delivered: id=w_331234, status=200, latency=14ms
jess: thanks team. target to finish canary and snapshot metrics by EOD. keep updates in this thread only. if alerts fire, escalate to eng-sre. :rocket:
